release_notes:
- Device tab: Activate and Deactivate now set and clear the real activation (the same one the Cardo app sets), not only the "skip activation check" flag
- Device tab: Deactivate also clears the "skip activation check" flag if it is set, so the unit really ends up not activated
- Device tab: fixed both Activate and Deactivate staying disabled on units that never had CUSTOMER299 (most units)
- Device tab: the activation state is shown correctly for units activated through the app
- PS keys tab: Customer295 and Customer297 are shown as tables with named settings, like Customer299
- PS keys tab: Customer297 now shows and writes all its field-test settings; writing it no longer cuts the key short
- PS keys tab: Write sends only the values you changed and lists them before writing
- Reading the PS keys on any tab now also refreshes the Audio, FM, PS keys and Device tabs
- PS keys tab and DMC tab: an "i" mark shows groups that are not read from the shared PS key definitions yet
